best_idea: Pick a severity variant from the hit's damage and damage type by a fixed rule table, drop one tier when the variant is missing, end on a standard fall, and gate the heavy variant by a player presentation setting.
decision_why: Frankendom keeps the shape for the Pit finisher (tier by damage and type, fall back when the clip is missing, heavy presentation gated by a setting); no donor code is used (restricted licence) and the server sends the kill with damage and type, so the client chooses the clip and never decides the kill.
acceptance: A server-confirmed kill with damage 45 or more plays the heavy finisher clip for its damage type if present, else the mid clip; a minimal-setting client never plays the heavy clip; a server test asserts the kill event carries damage and damage type and that the kill outcome is identical at every client setting.
